query: For positive integers r_i and lambda > 0 bound the number of tuples 0 ≤ j_i ≤ r_i with sum j_i/r_i ≤ (m-lambda)/2 by 2 sqrt(m)/lambda times product (r_i+1).

items.informal_description: For any positive real number $\varepsilon$ and natural number $l$, the value of $l$ is less than or equal to the initial bound defined as $\max\left(7, \max\left(l, \left\lfloor \frac{\log(100 / \varepsilon^5)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor + 1\right)\right)$ in Szemerédi's regularity lemma.

items.informal_name: Minimum Partition Size Bound in Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma
items.type: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ), l ≤ SzemerediRegularity.bound ε l
items.informal_description: For any positive real number $\varepsilon$ and natural number $l$, the minimum partition size $l$ satisfies $l \leq \text{bound}(\varepsilon, l)$, where $\text{bound}(\varepsilon, l)$ is the tower-type bound defined as $\left(\text{stepBound}^{\left\lfloor 4/\varepsilon^5 \right\rfloor_+} (\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l))\right) \times 16^{\left(\text{stepBound}^{\left\lfloor 4/\varepsilon^5 \right\rfloor_+} (\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l))\right)}$. Here, $\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l) = \max\left(7, \max\left(l, \left\lfloor \frac{\log(100/\varepsilon^5)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor + 1\right)\right)$ and $\text{stepBound}(n) = n \times 4^n$.

query: The number of lattice points in a rectangular box below a weighted sum threshold is at most twice square root dimension divided by lambda times the number of points in the box.
